claim: Non-string backup or stage fields caused a traceback instead of fail-closed recovery.
evidence: A journal with integer and array paths raised TypeError.
Type validation now runs before Path construction.
impact: Corrupt recovery state could crash migration diagnostics.
required_action: Validate all journal paths as non-blank strings before filesystem access.

prevention.action: Journal path types are validated before any Path or filesystem operation.
prevention.fallback_reason: The journal is external persisted state, so runtime validation remains necessary.
